title: On-the-fly quant characterization service and safe-swap protocol for mixed-format execution
creator: Asha Patel
description: Ship a lightweight characterization service and an atomic safe-swap protocol that allow the runtime to: 1) quickly evaluate per-model and per-batch quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) under representative inputs, 2) attach an accuracy contract and degradation signature, and 3) perform live model/kernel swaps between FP16/FP8/INT8 execution paths with deterministic rollback on quality regressions. This ticket implements the service, integrates it with the calibration pipeline, and adds the canary harness + metrics used by the rollout controller.
acceptance_criteria: Characterization service produces a normalized profile JSON within 3s for 1k sample tokens on a baseline GPU
Each profile output includes: per-layer scale stats, quantization sensitivity score, expected token-latency delta, and a regression signature hash
Safe-swap protocol supports atomic switch with pre-swap dry-run and post-swap quality verification without dropping in-flight requests
Canary validation harness runs 1000 offline prompts, compares top-k outputs to FP16 baseline, and fails if accuracy delta > 0.6% on any critical eval set
Telemetry emitted: profile_id, sample_hash, sensitivity_score, latency_delta_estimate, swap_outcome, rollback_reason
E2E integration test that simulates degraded profile and validates automatic rollback within 5s
implementation_notes: Service: Go microservice colocated in runtime control plane, exposes /characterize and /verify endpoints
Characterization flow: sample runner -> per-layer activations extraction -> offline quant-sim step -> sensitivity scoring module
Score fn: combination of KL divergence on logits, top-k token overlap, and per-layer scale variance
Storage: profiles persisted in profile-store (existing keyspace), TTL 30d, signed by runtime to prevent tampering
Safe-swap: two-phase commit pattern - PREPARE (dry-run on canary shard) -> COMMIT (atomic pointer swap) with fallback to previous profile on failure
Concurrency: in-flight KV cache must be snapshot before switch; implement lightweight quiesce window <= 200ms
Granularity: support whole-model and per-block swap (for large decoder stacks), with affinity hints for layers intolerant to INT8
Interfaces: new runtime RPCs: CharacterizeModel(model_id, sample_set_id) and SwapExecutionPath(model_id, profile_id, mode=atomic)
test_plan: Unit: sensitivity scoring functions with synthetic logits and known divergences
Integration: characterization service + runtime in staging cluster using GPT-medium-style model
Canary: run on 10% of traffic using canary routing; monitor accuracy contracts and latency SLOs for 48h before ramp
Chaos: simulate bad profile (overquantized) and validate rollback triggers with false-positive rate analysis
Perf: ensure characterization latency P95 < 5s for 2k token samples on p4d-equivalent nodes
